claims: As of April 2026, Alec Bohm is the Philadelphia Phillies third baseman.
Alec Bohm's parents are Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm.
As of April 2026, Alec Bohm is involved in a lawsuit against Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm.
The lawsuit alleges that Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm misappropriated over $500,000 of Alec Bohm's money for personal expenses.
Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm have denied these allegations.
Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm are defending themselves against the claims.
Alec Bohm filed the lawsuit against his parents.
The lawsuit was filed in March 2026.
According to the lawsuit filed in March 2026, Alec Bohm alleges his parents used several LLCs to funnel money from his personal accounts for their own use, including paying personal expenses.
Alec Bohm is seeking an injunction to return over $500,000.
The lawsuit accuses Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm of transferring $528,618 to a trust account in their attorney's name.
Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm have denied any wrongdoing.
Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm stated they have acted in their son's best interests.
Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm stated they are "deeply saddened" by the allegations.
Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm had been managing certain financial affairs for Alec Bohm.
The financial setup involved LLCs that Daniel Bohm and Lisa Bohm claimed were for administrative purposes.
The situation has created a public family dispute amidst the start of the 2026 MLB season.
